concepts.name: Why Kinesis exists
concepts.line: Not mandatory; databases like MongoDB can ingest directly; Kinesis helps with large continuous event flow, less database pressure, replay and independent processing

concepts.name: PUT and GET
concepts.line: Producer -- PUT --> Kinesis <-- GET -- Consumer

concepts.name: Producer
concepts.line: Application or service that sends records to Kinesis

concepts.name: Record
concepts.line: One individual event / data item

concepts.name: Stream
concepts.line: The Kinesis resource that receives and holds records temporarily

concepts.name: Shard
concepts.line: One parallel lane inside a stream

concepts.name: Partition key
concepts.line: Routing value: you choose the key, Kinesis chooses the shard

concepts.name: Sequence number
concepts.line: Assigned by Kinesis inside a shard; position / order within that shard

concepts.name: Ordering
concepts.line: Preserved within a shard, not globally across shards

concepts.name: Provisioned vs on-demand
concepts.line: Provisioned: you manage shard capacity. On-demand: AWS manages scaling

concepts.name: Shard capacity
concepts.line: Around 1 MB/s and 1,000 records/s writes; around 2 MB/s reads

concepts.name: Throttling
concepts.line: Writes above capacity can be rejected; the producer should retry

concepts.name: PutRecord
concepts.line: Sends one record

concepts.name: PutRecords
concepts.line: Sends a batch of records; partial failures are possible

concepts.name: Retention
concepts.line: How long Kinesis keeps records available

concepts.name: Replay
concepts.line: Re-reading retained events from an earlier point

concepts.name: Consumer-side reading
concepts.line: A downstream system reads records from Kinesis

concepts.name: Consumer lag
concepts.line: How far behind a reader is from the newest events

concepts.name: Standard consumer
concepts.line: Readers share the shard's read capacity

concepts.name: Enhanced fan-out
concepts.line: Each registered consumer gets dedicated read capacity

concepts.name: Retention period
concepts.line: The configurable length of time records are kept

concepts.name: Recovering after a consumer failure
concepts.line: Resuming reads from retained records after a consumer stops

concepts.name: Provisioned vs on-demand: when to use each
concepts.line: Choosing a scaling mode

concepts.name: Resharding: split and merge shards
concepts.line: Changing the number of shards in a stream

concepts.name: Scaling up and scaling down
concepts.line: Growing and shrinking stream capacity
